description: Tightly scoped: Renovate only watches the LLM e2e harness's pinned Claude Code CLI version, test/e2e-llm/package.json — the only npm manifest in this repo. No other deps are managed here. SOL-152586 briefly extended this to also cover Go modules and GitHub Actions instead of using Dependabot, since Dependabot cannot attach a sign-off of its own and the workflow-based `DCO sign-off` gate in force at the time required one — but Renovate cannot be enrolled for a public repository under the org's current system, so that extension was reverted (SOL-152808) before this repo goes public. Go modules and GitHub Actions are covered by .github/dependabot.yml instead. Dependabot's own commit-message config has no field for a DCO Signed-off-by trailer, so its pull requests cannot carry one; the CNCF dco2 App that enforces the required `DCO` check passes them anyway, confirmed on PR #289 — so no exemption is needed, and the workflow-level one that used to provide it was retired with .github/workflows/dco.yaml in SOL-153050. The ignorePaths below is more load-bearing now than it was before the revert, not less: config:base resolves to config:recommended, which folds in :ignoreModulesAndTests, whose own ignorePaths covers `**/test/**` among others — a pattern that matches test/e2e-llm/package.json. The single top-level ignorePaths here replaces that list rather than extending it, and that replacement is the only reason Renovate sees the CLI pin at all. Before the revert, dropping it as apparent redundancy would have silently lost two of three jobs; now it would silently switch off the only job this config exists for, with no signal that anything changed. Bumps follow npm's `stable` dist-tag (deliberately lagged from `latest`); see test/e2e-llm/README.md for the bump procedure. Top-level `commitBody` carries the DCO sign-off that the required `DCO` check requires, and is top-level rather than per-rule so it also covers lock-file maintenance and config-migration branches. The address must match the identity Renovate commits under (the hosted GitHub App uses this one), otherwise its PRs go red on that check — the fix is to correct the address here, never to look for a way to exempt the bot. Enforcement is the App's; there is no repo-side exemption knob left to reach for.

prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `./run-all.sh` twice from `test/e2e-llm/` against the candidate version, confirm 16/16 pass both times. See the README's bump procedure.
